note: Real-time takes for capture_realtime.py: the game's own recorder in a real window (3024x1666 on the capture Mac's Retina display, UI scale 1, so the HUD is the same physical size as in the 4256x2800 tick-stepped frames). Each take keeps the framing of tools/shots.json at `scale` of its old pixel size: the in-game zoom is the old zoom times `scale`, the camera is centred on the same tile, then nudged down by `nudge_y` native pixels (a middle-button map drag) so the edit's crop clears the event list at the top left. Pans are done in the edit as a sliding crop over the recorded frame, not in the game.
erase_zones_note: The colony's clearing, forbidden and guard zones are left as the colony's AI paints them and are drawn as a player sees them (user decision, 2026-11-27): erasing them in real time could not keep up with the AI repainting, so zones popped in and out, and erasing changed the AI's play. shots.json's erase_zones applies only to the tick-stepped capture.
